brand.name: Riverbend Brewing Co.
brand.one_line_description: A small coastal-forest brewery making clean, bright IPAs meant for the trailhead and the tideline alike.
brand.mission: To brew beer that tastes like the place it's made — clean, unforced, and better outside.
brand.vision: In five years, Riverbend is the beer in the cooler at every trailhead and dock on this coast, poured by the people who fish and hike it.
core_values: Brewed for outside, not just for the bar
Small batches, brewed close to home
brand.positioning_statement: For people who'd rather be outside than in a taproom, Riverbend Brewing makes IPAs like Tide & Treetop that are bright, clean, and built to travel, because the best beer is the one you can actually take with you.
brand.differentiation: Brewed and packaged specifically for outdoor use — cans built for coolers and packs, a hop profile tuned for bright flavor without heavy bitterness, and label art that marks a specific stretch of coast and forest rather than generic 'craft' branding.

product.name: Tide & Treetop India Pale Ale
product.description: A 330mL can of India Pale Ale at 6.5% ALC/VOL, brewed for bright hop character and a clean finish, packaged for the outdoors.
key_features: Bright hops with a clean, non-lingering finish
330mL can, sized and built for coolers, packs, and trail carry
Label art marking the specific coastline and forest the brewery takes its name from
top_benefits: A hop-forward IPA that doesn't leave a heavy, bitter aftertaste
A can format that travels easily to the trail, the beach, or the dock
A flavor and strength built for an afternoon outside, not a heavy night in
product.proof_points: Brewed in batches of under 500 barrels at a time; dry-hopped twice for aromatic brightness without added bitterness; named one of the coast's top new IPAs by two regional craft beer guides in its debut year.
product.category: Most people reach for whatever IPA is on sale or already familiar from national craft beer brands, without a clear option built specifically for taking outdoors.

audience.primary_audience: Outdoor-active adults, 25-40, who hike, fish, camp, or spend weekends near the coast and drink craft beer regularly.
audience.demographics: Coastal and mountain-town residents and weekend visitors, mixed income, buy craft beer by the case or four-pack from grocery stores, breweries, and outdoor retailers.
audience.psychographics: Prefers experiences over polish; skeptical of overly hoppy, bitter 'extreme' IPAs; wants a beer that fits into a day outside rather than being the main event.
pain_points: Many IPAs are too bitter or heavy to drink more than one of in an afternoon outside
Glass bottles are impractical or against the rules on trails, beaches, and boats
Hard to find a local option that isn't either mass-market or overly niche
audience.desired_outcome: Cracking a beer at the end of a hike or a day on the water that tastes bright and clean, without weighing down the pack or the afternoon.
audience.objections: Price is higher than mainstream domestic beer; unfamiliar independent brand name; concern that 'IPA' means overly bitter for casual drinkers.
audience.secondary_audience: Outdoor gear shops, campgrounds, and marinas looking to stock a local beer that matches their customers' activities.

we_are: Specific about where and how the beer is made
Focused on real outdoor moments, not staged lifestyle shots
Written like someone describing a good day outside, not selling a beer
we_are_not: Extreme or bitter-forward in how we describe hop character
Using generic craft-beer cliches like 'hand-crafted' or 'brewed with passion'
tone.example_line: Bright hops, clean finish, built to fit in a pack.

offer.core_offer: Buy a 4-pack, get a Riverbend bottle opener and carabiner clip free.
offer.pricing_packaging: $14.99 per 4-pack of 330mL cans; available in 4-packs, 12-packs, and on tap at partner taprooms.
offer.urgency_reason: Small-batch brewing means each release sells out before the next batch is ready, usually within 3-4 weeks.
offer.guarantee: If your first 4-pack isn't the beer you wanted for the trail, we'll swap it for another Riverbend style, no questions asked.
offer.post_conversion: Welcome email shares the story behind the Tide & Treetop label art, the next release date, and where to find Riverbend on tap nearby.
